lead.hed: USS New Orleans changed commanding officers in Sasebo
lead.insight: The Navy said Thursday that Capt. Kevin Dean turned over the San Antonio-class amphibious transport dock USS New Orleans to Capt. Steven Zielechowski on the ship's flight deck in Sasebo. Dean had the ship since Dec. 30, 2024, through a seven-month patrol that included Iron Fist with Japan's Maritime Self-Defense Force plus Operations Epic Fury and Ernest Tide. Zielechowski had been deputy commander of Naval Surface Group Western Pacific and officer in charge of the Sasebo detachment. New Orleans is part of the Tripoli Amphibious Readiness Group, forward deployed with 7th Fleet. A change of command, not a new deployment order.
lead.image_credit: Mass Communication Specialist 2nd Class Julia Leon · DVIDS 9978274 · Public domain · Capt. Steven Zielechowski salutes Capt. Timothy Carter after assuming command of USS New Orleans in Sasebo, Japan, Oct. 1, 2026.

political.hed: The cruiser Robert Smalls left Japan for San Diego, the last cruiser on that station
political.insight: U.S. 7th Fleet said Wednesday that the Ticonderoga-class cruiser USS Robert Smalls left Yokosuka for a permanent homeport change to San Diego. Rear Adm. Jeffrey L. Heames, commander of Carrier Strike Group 5, said she is the last cruiser to leave Japan. The ship arrived in 2015 as USS Chancellorsville and was renamed Robert Smalls in 2023. Arleigh Burke-class destroyer USS Mustin replaces her. A homeport shift, not a decommissioning.

political.hed: About four dozen Camp Lejeune Marines will join NATO's Baltic Sentry
political.insight: U.S. Marine Corps Forces Europe and Africa said Thursday that a team already in Europe will be retasked to the Baltic Sea for the NATO-led Enhanced Vigilance Activity Baltic Sentry. About four dozen Marines from 2nd Reconnaissance Battalion and II Marine Expeditionary Force Information Group, both at Camp Lejeune, will work with Finland's Coastal Brigade on expeditionary surveillance and reconnaissance aimed at undersea infrastructure. Maj. Gen. Daniel Shipley said the Marines are in a supporting role under Allied Joint Force Command Brunssum. A tasking, not a new deployment order from the United States.

tech.hed: An essay says the new fiscal year inherits a debt past $40 trillion
tech.insight: Law & Liberty, Thursday: the fiscal year that began today inherits last year's commitments. The essay says gross federal debt passed $40 trillion during fiscal 2026, that the 10-year Treasury yield hit 5 percent in the final weeks of that year, and that the Congressional Budget Office projects annual net interest costs rising from $1 trillion in fiscal 2026 to $2.1 trillion in fiscal 2036. Those payments service old borrowing. An essay, not a Treasury release and not a floor vote.

culture.hed: First Things says Texas put short Bible passages on the required school list
culture.insight: First Things, Thursday: the Texas State Board of Education approved a required K-12 reading list that includes a short Bible passage or two in each grade, mixed with longer works such as Hamlet and Pride and Prejudice. The magazine notes the national coverage that followed and argues the objection treats Scripture as the one text public schools may not assign. An essay on a state board action, not a new statute.
